provenance: Original Bagisto-specific commerce design knowledge bundled with this skill; no external runtime source is required.
principles: Make the brand recognizable through composition, type, imagery, and interaction rather than a logo alone.
Give each page one dominant customer task while keeping price, availability, options, and recovery states explicit.
Use expressive composition on discovery surfaces and progressively reduce variance and motion toward checkout.
Treat merchant content, catalog data, channel data, and extension output as separate authoritative systems.
Design mobile and RTL as intentional compositions, not compressed desktop layouts.
Use semantic tokens and complete component states before adding decorative effects.
Prefer server-rendered commerce truth with focused Vue enhancement.
Reject visual novelty that cannot pass accessibility, performance, licensing, and content-extreme checks.

archetypes.name: Editorial Story Commerce
archetypes.concept: Use disciplined editorial rhythm to move customers from brand desire into precise product evidence.
signature: alternating narrow and wide text measures
archetypes.surface: quiet canvas, fine borders, selective tactile accents
archetypes.imagery: art-directed product still life, macro material detail, restrained lifestyle context
avoid: campaign imagery hiding price and actions

archetypes.name: Playful Guided Discovery
archetypes.concept: Turn a broad catalog into a joyful guided journey while preserving adult trust, safety, and comparison clarity.
composition: trust and learning evidence near decisions
signature: small cause-and-effect delight on discovery actions
archetypes.surface: bright paper-like surfaces with strong ink and limited saturated accents
archetypes.imagery: inclusive play scenes, clear scale cues, product-in-use, safety detail
avoid: motion that competes with product scanning

archetypes.name: Technical Confidence Retail
archetypes.concept: Make complex products feel comparable and trustworthy through structured evidence and precise interaction states.
archetypes.surface: crisp neutral layers, firm borders, restrained elevation
archetypes.imagery: clean product angles, detail crops, scale and compatibility diagrams

archetypes.name: Natural Evidence Commerce
archetypes.concept: Pair calm discovery with ingredient, origin, and efficacy evidence at the exact point of customer doubt.
archetypes.surface: warm natural canvas, mineral borders, low elevation
archetypes.imagery: ingredient macro, process, origin, honest product texture
avoid: decorative nature imagery without product proof

archetypes.name: Heritage Craft Market
archetypes.concept: Use provenance, material, and maker detail to make craftsmanship legible without sacrificing modern commerce speed.
archetypes.surface: tactile warm neutrals, honest borders, restrained texture
archetypes.imagery: hands, process, material detail, lived-in product context
avoid: story content separating product from purchase

archetypes.name: High-Velocity Retail
archetypes.concept: Optimize repeat discovery and comparison with compact, predictable modules and unmistakable value signals.
archetypes.surface: clean high-contrast panels with economical elevation
archetypes.imagery: consistent product crops, packaging clarity, useful quantity context
avoid: large storytelling blocks interrupting repeat purchase

archetypes.name: Lifestyle Collection Retail
archetypes.concept: Connect products through coordinated use, collection, and context while keeping individual items easy to compare.
archetypes.surface: neutral gallery surfaces with collection-specific accents
archetypes.imagery: contextual lifestyle scenes paired with consistent catalog crops

archetypes.name: Precision Minimal Commerce
archetypes.concept: Use exact proportions, typography, and product detail to create distinction without decorative excess.
archetypes.surface: flat architectural planes, exact borders, almost no shadow
archetypes.imagery: controlled object studies, close construction detail, neutral context

archetypes.name: Celebration Gift Commerce
archetypes.concept: Reduce gift anxiety with occasion-led discovery, delivery confidence, and a warm reveal moment.
archetypes.surface: warm light surfaces with celebratory accent moments
archetypes.imagery: gift-ready packaging, recipient context, scale and unboxing detail

typography.name: Friendly Structured
typography.display: approved self-hosted rounded or humanist display face
typography.body: installed humanist sans or system sans fallback
rules: Use open counters and sturdy weights
Keep price and safety copy highly legible
Reserve expressive type for short headings

typography.name: Editorial Contrast
rules: Use display contrast only at large sizes
Keep prices, options, and forms in the sans family
Limit heading line length and avoid fragile thin weights

typography.name: Technical Grotesk
rules: Use tabular numerals for price and specifications
Prefer weight and spacing over decorative display faces

typography.name: Warm Humanist
typography.display: approved self-hosted humanist serif or sans
rules: Keep evidence and ingredient copy scannable

typography.name: Retail Utility
rules: Create hierarchy with size and weight, not many typefaces

typography.name: Architectural Neutral
typography.display: approved self-hosted neo-grotesk or restrained serif
rules: Never reduce size to manufacture sophistication
Use spacing and rules to carry structure

home: brand promise and one primary route
product: title, price, tax, review, stock, options, quantity, primary action

laravel: Keep meaningful commerce content server rendered
Preserve route, CSRF, validation, session, event, and controller contracts
Use repositories and existing API endpoints for authoritative data
vue: Preserve existing app registration, emitter, refs, validation, and component contracts
Synchronize ARIA state and restore focus for drawers, dialogs, tabs, and errors
html-tailwind: Map design roles to CSS custom properties or a centralized Tailwind extension
Preserve installed content globs and compatibility tokens
Use logical properties, visible focus, reduced motion, reserved media ratios, and content-driven breakpoints
